rationale: The interpreter output contains unsupported assumptions and leaves several critical ambiguities unresolved, preventing a reliable implementation of the autopopulation logic.

findings.description: The interpreter assumes that entries with isActive=false must always be excluded, but the ticket never specifies this behavior.
findings.action: Clarify whether inactive entries should be excluded from the filtered dropdowns.

findings.description: The ticket does not define how the Condenser Type maps to Unit Type filtering; the example data only shows refrigerant parents.
findings.action: Obtain clarification on the Condenser Type mapping required for filtering Unit Type options.

sourceRefs.quote: The Condenser Type mapping is unclear because the example parent data contains refrigerants.

findings.description: The ticket does not specify the expected behavior when a filter yields no results (empty dropdown).
findings.action: Clarify the desired UI/UX behavior when filtering results in an empty Unit Type or Unit Size list.

findings.description: The ticket does not define case sensitivity rules or how downstream selections should be reset after a change.
findings.action: Obtain clarification on case sensitivity handling and whether changing a higher‑level selection should reset dependent dropdowns.

sourceRefs.quote: Case sensitivity and downstream selection reset behavior are unspecified.
